_about: DRAFT Fact Check! statements written 26 Nov 2026 to extend the schedule past 30 Dec 2026. Status: pending owner approval. They were checked editorially, not against the named sources; none is served or scheduled until approved. To approve: append the approved rows to facts.js, then run node scripts/build-content.mjs and node scripts/validate-questions.mjs (see docs/content/RUNBOOK.md).
rows: Queen Victoria became queen at the age of 28.
The Battle of Trafalgar was fought in 1905.
It was fought a century earlier, in Nelson's day.
The Gunpowder plotters hid 36 barrels of gunpowder under Parliament.
Guy Fawkes was caught guarding them.
The Great Fire of London destroyed about 13,200 houses.
Henry VIII became king at the age of 27.
The Berlin Wall was about 15 km long.
About 155 km: it ran all the way round West Berlin.
The Titanic was about 269 metres long.
882 ft 9 in, the largest ship afloat when she sailed.
The Wars of the Roses lasted about 30 years.
The Great Pyramid was the world's tallest building for about 3,800 years.
Until Lincoln Cathedral's spire overtook it around 1311.
Cleopatra died more than 2,000 years after the Great Pyramid was built.
The pyramid dates from about 2560 BC; Cleopatra died in 30 BC.
The first modern Olympics had athletes from 40 countries.
About 241 athletes from 14 countries, in Athens.
George Washington became the first US President in 1789.
The USA bought Alaska from Russia for about $72 million.
The Eiffel Tower took about 10 years to build.
About 2 years, finished in time for the World's Fair.
Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel
Each face on Mount Rushmore is about 18 metres tall.
About 60 feet from chin to forehead.
The Colosseum in Rome could seat more than 40,000 spectators.
The Leaning Tower of Pisa took about 20 years to finish.
About 200 years, with long pauses for war.
Each of Big Ben's clock faces is about 7 metres across.
Stonehenge's biggest stones weigh around 25 tonnes.
The largest sarsens weigh about 25 to 30 tonnes.
Light takes about 1.3 seconds to reach Earth from the Moon.
Moonlight is reflected sunlight, so it's about 8 minutes old by the time you see it.
Saturn has fewer than 10 known moons.
It has well over 200 confirmed moons, the most of any planet.
Jupiter is about 3 times wider than Earth.
Neptune is the 8th planet from the Sun.
The farthest planet since Pluto was reclassified.
A water molecule has 2 hydrogen atoms and 1 oxygen atom.
Human DNA is about 99% the same as a chimpanzee's.
Most people blink about 15 to 20 times a minute.
More when talking, less when reading or staring at a screen.
Fingernails grow about 3 mm a month.
Toenails grow about a third as fast.
The brain makes up about 2% of an adult's body weight.
About 1.3 to 1.4 kg in an adult.
Lightning is about 5 times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
A bolt can heat the air to around 30,000 °C.
The Pacific Ocean covers about a tenth of Earth's surface.
About a third: more than all the land put together.
The Dead Sea is about 10 times saltier than the ocean.
Around 34% salt, against about 3.5% for sea water.
Antarctica holds about 70% of the world's fresh water.
Locked up in its ice sheet.
The Amazon rainforest covers about 5.5 million km².
Russia covers about 17 million km², an eighth of Earth's land.
Mainland Australia is about 4,000 km wide, wider than the Moon.
From Steep Point in the west to Cape Byron in the east.
It has 3: Eryri, the Pembrokeshire Coast and Bannau Brycheiniog.
Lough Neagh covers about 390 km², the UK's largest lake by area.
The Isle of Wight covers about 380 km².
A giraffe's heart weighs about 11 kg.
It has to pump blood up a 2-metre neck.
An elephant's trunk has about 400 muscles.
A blue whale's tongue can weigh around 2.7 tonnes.
About as much as an elephant.
A hummingbird beats its wings about 5 times a second.
Around 50 times a second, often more.
A cheetah can go from 0 to 60 mph in about 3 seconds.
A polar bear can smell a seal about 1.5 km away.
Nearly a mile, even under snow.
Sharks have existed for about 450 million years, longer than trees.
Trees appeared about 385 million years ago.
Bees visit about 2 million flowers to make 1 lb of honey.
Arctic terns fly about 7,000 km a year on migration.
About 70,000 km, pole to pole and back.
A male seahorse can give birth to more than 1,000 babies at once.
The female lays her eggs in his pouch.
There are more than 10,000 known species of bird.
Insects make up about 2% of known animal species.
More than half of all known animal species are insects.
Dogs have about 300 million smell receptors in their noses.
The pitch at Wembley Stadium is 150 metres long.
Today's marathon distance was fixed at the first London Olympics.
So the race could start at Windsor Castle and finish in front of the royal box.
Wimbledon gets through about 55,000 tennis balls each year.
Balls are changed every 7 to 9 games.
An Olympic gold medal is at least 92.5% silver.
It's covered with at least 6 g of gold.
The Tour de France covers about 1,000 km.
About 3,500 km over about three weeks.
Golf's Open Championship is played over 54 holes.
A Test cricket match can last up to 5 days.
With six hours' play scheduled each day.
An American football field is about 53 yards wide.
A doubles tennis court is 27 feet wide.
It's 36 ft; a singles court is 27 ft.
He won 6, all with the Chicago Bulls.
Pelé scored more than 1,000 goals in his career, by his own count.
The Grand National is run over more than 4 miles.
Elvis Presley had 3 US number-one singles.
He had 18 on the Billboard Hot 100.
'Happy Birthday to You' dates from the 1890s.
Its tune began as 'Good Morning to All' (1893).
Adele's album '21' is named after her age when she made it.
She was 21 while writing and recording it.
The first 'Toy Story' film is about 3 hours long.
'The Simpsons' has run for more than 35 seasons.
The longest-running US scripted primetime series.
'Coronation Street' has aired more than 11,000 episodes.
The original 'Star Wars' cost about $110 million to make.
Walt Disney voiced Mickey Mouse for about 20 years.
Until 1947, when Jimmy MacDonald took over.
The 'Harry Potter' films came out over 10 years.
J. K. Rowling's first Harry Potter book was turned down by 12 publishers.
The Very Hungry Caterpillar eats through 5 oranges on Friday.
One more piece of fruit each day, starting with 1 apple on Monday.
Roald Dahl's BFG is 24 feet tall.
Small for a giant: the others are about twice his size.
Just 3: sponge, orange jelly and chocolate.
Fry's made the first solid chocolate bar in the 1840s.
A Big Mac has 2 beef patties.
Ketchup was sold as a medicine in the 1830s.
Tomato pills were claimed to cure indigestion.
People in the UK drink about 10 million cups of tea a day.
Coca-Cola was first sold for 5 cents a glass.
A pineapple takes about 2 months to grow.
About 2 years, one fruit per plant at a time.
The first iPhone had a 3.5-inch screen.
The QWERTY keyboard layout dates from the 1870s.
Or 1,024 in the older binary usage.
International Bureau of Weights and Measures
The World Wide Web went public in 1991.
The first YouTube video is 19 minutes long.
A QR code can hold more than 4,000 characters.
The first computer mouse, built in 1964, was made of wood.
Alan Turing appears on the £50 note.
The painter J. M. W. Turner appears on the £20 note.
A UK 1p coin is solid copper.
The Royal Mint has made coins in Wales since 1968.
An adult UK passport lasts 15 years.
A UK driving test lasts about 2 hours.
Royal Mail delivers to more than 30 million addresses.
Six days a week for letters.
Britain's first roadside post boxes appeared in the 1850s.
The Trans-Siberian Railway from Moscow to Vladivostok is about 9,300 km long.
The world's shortest scheduled flight lasts under 2 minutes.
Westray to Papa Westray in Orkney.
The London Eye takes about 3 minutes to go round once.
Tower Bridge opens about 800 times a year.
For tall ships on the Thames.
The Angel of the North weighs about 20 tonnes.
The Statue of Liberty's face is about 2.5 metres tall.
The Sydney Harbour Bridge opened in 1962.
The Taj Mahal took about 20 years to build.
Built by Shah Jahan in memory of his wife.
Machu Picchu was built in the 1400s.
Venice is built on more than 100 small islands.
The largest freshwater lake by area.
The word 'set' has more than 400 meanings in the Oxford English Dictionary.
One of the longest entries in the dictionary.
Shakespeare is credited with inventing about 1,700 English words.
About 18% of people in Wales said they could speak Welsh in the 2021 Census.
An adult heart pumps about 75 litres of blood a day.
Most people lose about 50 to 100 hairs a day.
Normal shedding; new ones grow back.
The thigh bone is about a quarter of a person's height.
It's the longest bone in the body.
A Rubik's Cube has about 43 quintillion possible positions.
Cluedo was invented in Birmingham in the 1940s.
Minecraft has sold more than 300 million copies.
The best-selling video game of all time.
Mario has appeared in more than 200 video games.
The Nintendo Switch sold more than 100 million consoles.
High enough to see the curve of the Earth.
Le Shuttle takes about 35 minutes to cross under the Channel.
London black cabs must turn in a circle about 25 feet wide.
So they can turn round in narrow streets.
The M6 is Britain's longest motorway, at about 230 miles.
From the M1 near Rugby to the Scottish border.
